item.title: The lamp in the stairwell
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: attention is the one thing nobody can print more of, so watching became a trade, and both the watcher and the watched end up wondering how much of themselves is still theirs. The stairwell in my building has a lamp that answers to noise. On the way up, at the third landing, you stamp a foot or clap once and it comes on.

item.title: Allegedly the singularity has begun: three sums from an old-fashioned man
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: allegedly we are already inside the singularity. I will not argue about the word. I want to redo the three sums the argument rests on — who writes the code, how cheap intelligence has become, and what is left in the human column. A note on method: this is a reading note.

item.title: One hour a day, 365 hours a year: which half of Dan Koe's deep focus actually lands
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: the useful thing in the essay is not “use your phone less” — it is a budget you can compute: one hour a day, 365 hours a year, 45 full working days, all of them spent on your own project. Scope first. The source is Dan Koe’s long post How to unlock extreme focus on command, published on X on 19 January 2026; I read the full body.

item.title: Life is meaningless, the things you love are a con, and anger takes strength
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: meaninglessness is not bad news, and neither is the con. What has to be budgeted is strength — anger is physical work, and there is less of it every year. A note on what this is: three sentences I read, carried further into six thoughts at night.
